content: Supabase/Postgres RLS policies are OR-composed and evaluated per-row, not per-statement-shape -- there is no native 'this is a bulk call' predicate. To let one INSERT policy already used by regular users coexist with an admin-only bulk path on the same table, either (a) gate the bulk business rule procedurally inside a non-SECURITY-DEFINER RPC (raise exception if not admin; underlying per-row INSERT policy remains the real backstop), or (b) tag rows with an origin column (e.g. origem_cadastro) and add a per-row predicate like (origem = 'import' -> is_admin()) to the INSERT policy, which is the stricter 'pure RLS' expression of the same rule.
